toyota-land-cruiser-vxr.name: Toyota Land Cruiser VXR
toyota-land-cruiser-vxr.description: The Toyota Land Cruiser VXR is the pinnacle of luxury offroad travel — rugged outside, incredibly plush inside with premium leather seats and multi-zone climate control. The preferred choice for executive travel across Cairo and long journeys across Egypt.

cadillac-escalade-esv.name: Cadillac Escalade ESV
cadillac-escalade-esv.description: Commanding presence with limousine-grade comfort. The Escalade ESV pairs cinema-grade rear seating with serious luggage space — perfect for VIP arrivals and family travel.

toyota-hiace-vip-lounge.name: Toyota Hiace VIP Lounge
toyota-hiace-vip-lounge.description: Experience first-class group travel. Fitted with bespoke captain reclining seats, conference tables, and custom ambient lighting, the Toyota Hiace VIP Lounge offers boardroom comfort on wheels for executive delegations and VIP private transfers.

toyota-fortuner.name: Toyota Fortuner
toyota-fortuner.description: A perfect blend of versatility and luxury. The Toyota Fortuner offers a highly refined ride with elevated seating, leather seats, and great cargo space. Ideal for daily corporate commutes, weddings, and airport transfers.

range-rover-vogue.name: Range Rover Vogue
range-rover-vogue.description: Effortless poise on any road. The Vogue blends British craftsmanship with elevated SUV comfort — equally at home at a hotel forecourt or a desert lodge.

toyota-hiace-luxury-tourer.name: Toyota Hiace Luxury Tourer
toyota-hiace-luxury-tourer.description: The ultimate group travel companion. With a high roof, ergonomic seating for up to 12 passengers, and massive luggage capacity, the Toyota Hiace Luxury Tourer is the perfect choice for corporate team trips, tourism, and airport pickups.
